title: Which Ukrainian suspect, if any, will be arrested in August 2026 in connection with Germany's investigation into the Nord Stream pipeline bombings?
background: Germany is investigating the September 2022 explosions that damaged the Nord Stream gas pipelines. A former Ukrainian army officer was arrested in Italy in August 2025 and transferred to Germany that November.
resolution_criteria:
Source of Truth : Confirmation from German federal prosecutors or the authorities carrying out the arrest, as reported by reliable news organizations. 
  Resolution Conditions : Identify the Ukrainian suspect physically arrested during August 2026 pursuant to a German warrant concerning the September 2022 Nord Stream pipeline bombings. The issuance of a warrant without an actual arrest does not qualify. 
  Accepted Answer Format : The suspect's full name. If no qualifying arrest occurs during August 2026, answer “None”.
